title: FBI TSC AI procurement lineage and public personnel — depth 2
summary: Public notices establish a contracting-officer procurement cluster but no authenticated public respondent list for FBI-TSC-AIE.

sources.title: TSC RFI for AI Enhancement Services Final.pdf

data.question: What public acquisition lineage and named personnel can be established around FBI-TSC-AIE without inventing applicants?
data.method: Exact notice searches, procurement-contact pivoting, official FBI personnel review and bounded respondent search.
findings: FBI-TSC-AIE names Brandon James as contracting officer and required capability packages to be emailed directly to him.
No authenticated respondent list, capability package, briefing roster, evaluation matrix, follow-on solicitation or selected vendor was located.
conclusions: Do not label a company a respondent without direct response, briefing or award evidence.
Acquire FBI response logs and market-research records before enumerating bid participants.
limitations: Email-submitted RFI responses are not publicly posted by default.
unresolved: Every FBI-TSC-AIE respondent and response-linked person.
Current TSC requirement owner and technical evaluators.

title: FBI-TSC-AIE respondent, evaluation and briefing records — depth 3

data.research_question: Which entities responded to FBI-TSC-AIE, who represented them, and which government personnel evaluated or briefed them?
hypotheses: Response-receipt and market-research records identify respondents even where technical submissions are withheld.
objectives: Obtain response-receipt logs and respondent business identifiers.
Obtain market-research reports, capability matrices and briefing rosters.
Enumerate personnel only when direct participation evidence exists.

title: FBI TSC AI procurement-lineage research pass — depth 2
summary: Completed a public-source pass over the contracting-officer notice cluster; respondent identities remain blocked pending records.

data.research_question: What is the next public-source layer around FBI-TSC-AIE after the respondent list could not be located?
data.method: Procurement-contact pivoting, exact notice search, official personnel verification and status separation.
classification_rules: An RFI response is not an offer or award.
Capability similarity is not respondent evidence.

findings.finding: Brandon James is the direct public contracting contact for FBI-TSC-AIE.
A public FBI-TSC-AIE respondent list was located.

data.next_action: Acquire response, evaluation and briefing metadata; then enumerate each confirmed respondent's bid-linked personnel.
